title: Lawyer.  Passport.  Locksmith.  Gun.  (A Talk About Risk & Preparedness)
summary: Deviant Ollam gives a long talk on risk and preparedness: get a lawyer, passport, locksmith and other resources before you need them. It covers practical steps to build defenses against serious problems in life.
why: Recommended as a thorough preparedness talk, and cited for specifics such as lawyers, password managers and gun ownership.

quote.text: it's worth an hour of your time.
